title: Import from Vanilla Forums & NodeBB
notes: Two more sources in the Import wizard. Vanilla Forums brings across categories, members, discussions and comments, converting each post from its stored format (HTML / Markdown / BBCode / Rich). NodeBB stores its data in Redis rather than SQL, so you connect its Redis host/port and Convoro reads it directly, converting Markdown to formatting. Members reset their password on first login.

changelog.text: Vanilla Forums importer (MySQL) — handles per-post formats: HTML, Markdown, BBCode and Rich (Quill).
NodeBB importer — reads NodeBB's Redis store directly (connect by Redis host/port/db), converting Markdown posts to formatting.
